req.title: Register form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-002 requires GET /auth/register to return HTTP 2xx with a registration form. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET returns 200 with form fields present; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST without data) still returns 200 but via the same route, and a truly wrong path returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — response body contains exact HTML landmarks (form action, input names) to catch mutations that alter template rendering or route registration. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_register_get_returns_200
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a temporary database
trace: R-FLASKR-002: system shall serve registration form at GET /auth/register
EP: valid method on valid endpoint → 200
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.sqlite')
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.data) > 0
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'text/html' in ct

test_register_get_returns_200()
